advisory-boundary.title: Read-only advisory workspace.
advisory-boundary.description: Scale never activates, pauses, deletes, or changes budgets or delivery settings in Meta. Conversions create unsubmitted drafts that keep their downstream preview, cost, QC, Experiment, and confirmation gates.

action-denied.invalid_lifecycle: Not allowed in the current lifecycle state
action-denied.owner_required: Only the Workspace Owner can do this.
action-denied.thread_not_active: This advice thread is no longer active
action-denied.advice_type_not_convertible: This advice type cannot be converted

list.empty-description: Enroll a Winner to start monitoring its Scale evidence.

candidate-selector.title: New Enrollment
candidate-selector.description: Select an eligible Winner decision, then name the delivery target to enroll.
candidate-selector.empty: No eligible Winner decisions are available for this Meta mode.
candidate-selector.manual-entry-description: Enter the identifiers for the Winner decision to enroll. This is a manual-entry seam until server-computed candidate eligibility is available.
candidate-selector.marketing-origin: Marketing: combination confirmed under recorded conditions
candidate-selector.marketing-boundary: This combination is supported only under the recorded conditions and user-supplied delivery evidence. Choose a currently compatible observed delivery target. This prepares monitoring and never creates, activates or changes an ad.
candidate-selector.delivery-not-ready: Complete current source-market truth and asset readiness, then sync the matching actual delivery through an authorized read-only connection. No compatible observed target is ready yet; monitoring cannot be created.
candidate-selector.observed-ads-title: Pick the ad this Winner runs in
candidate-selector.observed-ads-description: These are the ads your connections in this mode have observed. MarketAI makes the delivery target from what it recorded about the ad and only reads; it never creates or changes an ad.
candidate-selector.observed-ads-empty: No connection in this mode has observed an ad yet.
candidate-selector.observed-ad-unmapped: No creative version recorded for this ad

activate-dialog.title: Activate enrollment
activate-dialog.description: Activating opens the first Episode. Delivery config and Episode context normally come from a synced Meta read; this form is a manual-entry seam until that prefill lands.
activate-dialog.preview-description: Create an activation preview before opening the first Episode.
activate-dialog.confirm-description: Review the activation preview reference, then confirm activation.
activate-dialog.reconciliation-required: The previous attempt is ambiguous. Retry to reconcile.

evidence.heading: Evidence
evidence.no-active-episode: This enrollment has no active episode, so there is no evidence to show.

state.waiting-title: Waiting for the first complete day
state.waiting-body: Monitoring has started. Evidence is built from complete days in the ad account's time zone, so the first evaluation runs once the first full day has been read from Meta.
state.collected-body: Data through {{day}} is in. Its first evaluation is running.
state.blocked-body: The latest Meta data, for {{day}}, can't be used, so this ad isn't evaluated and no health is shown.
state.stale-body: The evaluation below is from {{day}} and is out of date.
state.pending-body: Data through {{day}} is in and being evaluated. The evaluation below is from {{evaluated}}.

quality-issue.daily_slot_missing: Daily data is missing for a day
quality-issue.exact_window_value_unavailable: Reach and frequency for the window are unavailable
quality-issue.delivery_configuration_incompatible: Delivery settings changed and cannot be compared
quality-issue.freshness_slo_exceeded: Data is older than the freshness limit
quality-issue.source_pagination_incomplete: Source data was not fully paged
quality-issue.source_contract_mismatch: Source data does not match the metric contract
quality-issue.source_timezone_mismatch: Source time zone does not match

source-issue.connection_ineligible: The Meta connection is not active
source-issue.source_provenance_mismatch: The Meta data doesn't match this ad's account, time zone, currency or ad
source-issue.contract_instance_failed: A required Meta read is missing or doesn't match the metric contract
source-issue.reconciliation_unresolved: The result of a Meta read is unconfirmed
source-issue.incomplete_pagination: Meta returned only some pages of a read
source-issue.transport_exhausted: A Meta read failed, even after retries
source-issue.freshness_slo_exceeded: Some of the data is older than the freshness limit
source-issue.exact_window_value_unavailable: Reach and frequency are unavailable for a window without delivery

recovery.repair_connection: Reconnect or repair the Meta connection in Settings. Collection resumes with the next daily sync.
recovery.wait_for_next_sync: Nothing to do now. The next daily Meta sync collects the data again.
recovery.reconcile_meta_sync: An operator has to confirm the unresolved Meta read. The next daily sync also collects the data again.
recovery.retry_meta_sync: The next daily Meta sync collects the data again. If this keeps happening, check the Meta connection in Settings.

health-reason.conflicting_signals: Health not classified: CTR declined while CPA or ROAS clearly improved.
health-reason.partial_adverse_signals: Health not classified: some signals are adverse, but they match no health pattern.
health-reason.signal_unavailable: Health not classified: a required signal could not be computed.
health-reason.quality_blocked: Health not classified: data quality is blocked.
health-reason.episode_window_incomplete: Health not classified yet: the Episode has data for {{days}} of the 14 complete days the 7-day comparison needs. Health and advice start once all 14 are in.

signal-reason.explained_by_pause: Explained by a delivery pause; not counted as a hit
signal-reason.bootstrap_unavailable: Too few valid samples for an interval
signal-reason.data_quality_blocked: Not computed: data quality is blocked
signal-reason.episode_window_incomplete: Not computed: the Episode is younger than the 14-day window

breakdowns.heading: Breakdowns

insufficient-reason.descriptive_only: This breakdown type does not report CPA/ROAS

breakdowns.no-snapshot: No evidence snapshot yet for this Episode
breakdowns.empty: No segments observed for this breakdown type yet.

advice-card.conversion-unsubmitted: No Generation, Experiment, or Meta action has been submitted.

targets.title: Targets
targets.owner-only: Only the Workspace Owner can publish or withdraw targets.

publish-dialog.title: Publish target
publish-dialog.no-contexts: No eligible contexts. A context needs at least one active or paused Enrollment with observed Episode currency.
publish-dialog.replaces-active-target: Publishing withdraws the active target this context has now.
